text: The benchmark suite is the cargo project benchmarks/ on branch bench (1e4005e..efaf30f) and no other branch until the branches are collapsed. Run from benchmarks/: cargo run --release -- [WHICH] [-t N] [-r N] [-s MiB] [--compare-to label=path]. Groups normal, long-n, long-repeats, protein; default 10 MiB; rows append to runs/results.tsv. On other branches benchmarks/ shows as untracked: its ignored runs/ and target/ stay behind.
